answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 240 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the mesa log exposes the live set and the lotus audit records each lapse. Keeping 119 aliases alive thus means 119 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the bridge quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 6 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
